notes.title: Demo update 1.5.0
notes.content: We replaced the 'Sandpit' level with 'Jungle'. It has roughly the same layout, but with more detail and pathways to explore!

notes.title: Demo update 1.4.0
notes.content:
Added ability to rebind keys

Added a look sensitivity setting

Added support for navigating back from menus using ESC

notes.title: Demo update 1.3.0
notes.content:
You can finally achieve something in the game! 🙂



For now there are two achievements (we'll add more later):

Sneaky Devil: Win a round as a hider

Jailer: Win a round as the seeker

notes.title: Demo update 1.2.0
notes.content:
Improved the capture grenade's visuals

Added subtle camera tilt when moving sideways or landing
